prompt:
Design a high-fidelity landscape desktop web app screenshot (1440 x 960, no browser chrome) for a real product catalogue CRUD tool used by a student and instructor during an Advanced Databases demo. It is a working interface, not a poster, graphic design specimen poster, concept art, or landing page. No product photos, no logos, no invented IDs, dates, counts, metrics, stock values, categories, products, or fields.

Direction: “Visible Grid Specimen”, inspired by Wim Crouwel’s rigorous grid-based type specimens. The grid is the actual armature of the application: aligned rows, exact label/value positions, and visibly consistent cell structure make the product schema easy to explain. Use cool white-gray #F4F6F7, deep ink #152735, strong cobalt #264FFF, and a sparing chartreuse #DBF566. Workhorse grotesk/sans typography, with bold oversize headings and monospaced data. Show a faint construction grid only where it improves alignment; no decorative grid overlay on empty backgrounds. No cream, no serif, no glow, no gradients.

The screenshot shows “Product catalogue”, a small “Sample data” marker, and a cobalt “Add product” action. Below, a product index and selected product inspector sit on one precise two-column grid: left is 44% of width, right is 56%. Search and category select are clearly labeled. Show exactly these product rows and values:
Samsung Galaxy A15 | Phones | ZMW 2,800 | Stock 14 | In stock
Tecno Spark 20 | Phones | ZMW 2,100 | Stock 22 | In stock
iPhone 13 | Phones | ZMW 11,500 | Stock 4 | Low stock
Cotton T-Shirt | Clothing | ZMW 150 | Stock 60 | In stock
Select Samsung Galaxy A15. Do not add any extra IDs, data or totals.

The right side shows an editable form for Samsung Galaxy A15 with exact labeled fields and values: Name Samsung Galaxy A15; Category Phones; Price (ZMW) 2800; Stock 14; Tags android and budget; Specs storage 128GB, ram 4GB, battery 5000mAh. Show Save product, Cancel, Delete. Beneath, clearly show “MongoDB document” and readable nested JSON with only name, category, price, stock, tags, specs and the same exact values; no ObjectId or timestamp. Use grid alignment to make the data hierarchy obvious without making it feel like a poster. Text sharp, contrast strong, interface straightforward and genuinely usable.
